lines: Unki berukhi
couplets.en: They turn away.

lines: Unki berukhi mein bhi iltifaat shaamil hai
couplets.en: Even their coldness holds a trace of tenderness.

lines: Unki
couplets.en: Even theirs.

lines: Unki berukhi mein bhi iltifaat shaamil hai
couplets.en: Even their coldness holds a trace of tenderness.

lines: Aajkal meri haalat dekhne ke qaabil hai
couplets.en: You should see what has become of me.

lines: Qatl ho to mera sa, maut ho to meri si
couplets.en: If one must be slain, if one must die, let it be as I did.

lines: Qatl ho to mera sa, maut ho to meri si
couplets.en: If one must be slain, if one must die, let it be as I did.

lines: Mere sogwaaron mein aaj mera qaatil hai
couplets.en: Today the one who killed me stands among my mourners.

lines: Aaj
couplets.en: Today.

lines: Har qadam pe mahroomi
couplets.en: At every step, something was denied me.

lines: Har qadam
couplets.en: At every step.

lines: Har qadam pe naakaami
couplets.en: At every step, I came up short.

lines: Ghaaliban koi dushman doston mein shaamil hai
couplets.en: Perhaps an enemy has found a place among my friends.

lines: Ghaaliban koi dushman doston mein shaamil hai
couplets.en: Perhaps an enemy has found a place among my friends.

lines: Uth rahe hain toofaan kyun
couplets.en: Why are the storms rising?

lines: Muztarib hain maujen kyun, uth rahe hain toofaan kyun
couplets.en: Why are the waves restless, why are the storms rising?

lines: Kya kisi safeene ko
couplets.en: Could it be that some ship longs?

lines: Kya kisi safeene ko aarzu-e-saahil hai
couplets.en: Does some ship long for shore?

lines: Sirf rahzan hi se kyun, Amir, shikwa ho
couplets.en: Amir, why lay all the blame on the bandit?

lines: Manzilon ki raahon mein rahbar bhi haa'il hai
couplets.en: On the road to your destination, even the guide stands in your way.
